title: maxObjectsInSet over-limit: limit, not requestTooLarge
description: Reported by mimid-13 (seen at d8a60f02), verified 2026-10-18. crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs:897-918 enforce_max_objects_in_set returns JmapError::limit("maxObjectsInSet"), which the HTTP layer maps to a request-level 400 RFC 7807 problem (doc at helpers.rs:894-896). RFC 8620 §5.3 (rfc8620.txt L2169): '"requestTooLarge": The total number of objects to create, update, or destroy exceeds the maximum number the server is willing to process in a single method call.' — a method-level error returned instead of the Foo/set response, so other method calls in the same request must still run. Fix: return the method error requestTooLarge; update the doc and the existing test enforce_max_objects_in_set_over_limit_returns_limit_error (helpers.rs:1625), which asserts the RFC-contradicting value (spec-driven change, quote L2169). Wire-breaking; record on JMAP-yt1w.3. mimid runs its own check first, so not blocking.
notes:
Fix: enforce_max_objects_in_set now returns JmapError::request_too_large() with description "maxObjectsInSet" (RFC 8620 §5.3 L2169) instead of JmapError::limit. Dispatcher already turns handler Err into an error invocation, so following calls still run (lib.rs test). Updated helpers.rs unit tests + 7 per-crate tests/max_objects_in_set.rs oracles (limit -> requestTooLarge), backend.rs doc. Uncommitted.
Done in 3edb32dd: tests helpers::tests::enforce_max_objects_in_set_over_limit_returns_request_too_large, tests::set_over_max_objects_is_method_error_request_too_large; changed existing tests: helpers::tests::enforce_max_objects_in_set_over_limit_returns_limit_error, helpers::tests::enforce_max_objects_in_set_sums_all_three, all *_over_limit* and *_at_limit_passes_cap_check tests (shared oracle expected_limit_error_shape)
